user.title: Add an independent price site
user.description: Create one independent pricing site. A single suitable official Nord Pool entry is suggested for confirmation; ambiguous sources require a choice. No contract or rates are copied from another site. Official Nord Pool uses ex-VAT DKK/MWh. An entity source must expose slots, currency, unit_of_measurement, vat_included and provider verified_at; unknown conventions fail closed. After adding the site, open Options to configure dated rates.

data.name: Site name
data.vat: Spot and automatic DSO VAT fraction (0.25 = 25%)
data.source_type: Spot source type (official Nord Pool or explicit entity contract)
data.price_unit: Confirmed input money unit (official Nord Pool: DKK/MWh)
data.price_basis: Confirmed input VAT/price basis (official Nord Pool: spot excluding VAT)
data.stale_minutes: Maximum provider verification age (minutes; entity source only)

dso.title: Grid tariff source
dso.description: Automatic Radius C verifies GLN 5790000705689, D03/DT_C_01 and coverage. Manual uses dated DSO rates. Fallback uses explicit dated manual DSO periods when the verified cache cannot cover the request. Expired or unavailable rates never become zero.

data.dso_mode: DSO source (manual or verified Radius C)
data.dso_manual_fallback: Allow explicit dated manual DSO fallback
data.dso_stale_days: Maximum age of last verified DSO cache (days)
data.dso_tariff_class: Tariff class (automatic Radius supports verified C only; other classes require manual dated rates)

add_rate.title: Add dated price component
add_rate.description: Use a verified per-site rate and exclusive end date. EWII household example is 0.030 DKK/kWh ex VAT from 2026-06-01 until 2026-10-01 only; do not apply it to later dates or another site. Subscriptions use DKK/month and are excluded from slot totals.

data.source: Source or contract reference (no customer identifiers)
data.eligibility: Eligibility (heating requires verified registration and usage)
data.hours: Local hours (blank = all day; use separate dated rates for manual time-of-use bands)

rate.title: Edit dated price component
rate.description: Change effective dates or amount; overlaps are rejected. Settled prices stay unchanged. Only affected future intervals are recalculated after Save.

edit_rate.title: Choose a dated rate to edit

remove_rate.title: Choose a dated rate to remove
remove_rate.description: Removal can leave future coverage incomplete. Existing settled history is retained.

taxes.title: Dated public baselines and tax eligibility
taxes.description: Optional documented baseline: 2026 Energinet net 0.043 and system 0.072 DKK/kWh ex VAT; uniform electricity tax 0.008 for 2026–2027. No 2028 rule or future TSO term is inferred. Household supplier contracts always require explicit per-site dated rates. Heating registration/annual usage are only used with an explicit verified heating rule, never an invented discount.

data.danish_public_rates: Use documented dated national baseline (not live legislative verification)

supplier.title: Supplier contract
supplier.description: Selecting EWII is a label, not a rate preset. Add your own verified dated supplier markup. The documented household historical example is 0.030 DKK/kWh excluding VAT for June–September 2026 only. No later or other-site terms are inferred. Other suppliers use Custom with the same dated rate editor.

storage.title: Create a verified local ledger backup
storage.description: {backup_result}\n\nSubmit to create a new verified SQLite snapshot. No prices, source configuration or controls change. Existing backups are never overwritten. Restore is deliberately offline-only: stop HA, compare backup revisions with recorded costs, preserve current files, then follow the beta recovery guide.

error.invalid_configuration: Invalid configuration. Check non-empty source, units/VAT, dates, overlapping periods and the official Nord Pool entry.
error.site_not_loaded: Load this pricing site before creating a backup.
error.backup_failed: Backup failed or the ledger did not pass verification. Preserve all files and check storage diagnostics.

abort.no_rates: There are no configured dated rates. Reopen Options and choose Add dated rate.
abort.site_not_loaded: Load this site to inspect stored prices.

confirm.title: Verify this pricing site again
confirm.description: Review this site’s Options and fix missing or expired supplier/grid/TSO/tax periods or its spot source. Submit to recheck sources. The warning only clears after complete verified current-day prices are READY; no charging controls are involved.

error.pricing_not_ready: Prices are still incomplete, stale or unavailable. Check site Options and diagnostics, then retry.

abort.site_not_loaded: This pricing site is not loaded. Check its integration entry.
